name: Rantorin
description: Rantorin, also known as OM812, was a barren rock planet with two moons. It occupied the second closest orbital position around the red giant star Thrantin Major in the Thrantin OM81-A system, a part of the Ollonir Boundaries in the Negs portion of the Colonies.
lead_paragraphs: Rantorin, also known as OM812, was a barren rock planet with two moons. It occupied the second closest orbital position around the red giant star Thrantin Major in the Thrantin OM81-A system, a part of the Ollonir Boundaries in the Negs portion of the Colonies.
